export_scope: Two byte-identical repeat Web exports from one clean guarded import. Browser validation is a separate required release gate.
scope: Tested incremental construction-feedback beta; not full-game acceptance.

construction_status_hud.scope: Controlled synthetic HUD transitions and read-only QA observations; not natural play or rendered-device acceptance

browser_validation.input: Chrome emulated touchscreen taps and ordinary touch swipes, not a physical phone
browser_validation.scenario: Natural house placement, builder Stop, stable no-builder progress across 20 simulation ticks, ordinary reassignment and resumed construction
browser_validation.screenshots: Actual 390px stopped/resumed screenshots inspected: readable guidance and active feedback, no missing glyphs or covered commands
browser_validation.network_gate: Both exact WASM/PCK GETs returned 200 with no-cache and normal finished events; zero observed browser errors, including after context close
browser_validation.fixture_cache_policy: Only the two exact pinned public streams use no-cache; all other fixture responses retain no-store. Fresh isolated context; public Pages uses its own static caching policy. Prior failed no-store runs are not reclassified.

validation_limits: Physical iPhone/Android, audible audio, complete construction, full combat play and long-match acceptance are not established by this focused browser run.
Earlier economy runs had gameplay evidence but failed overall network gates; they remain failed.
Browser validation used exact exported bytes on a hosted loopback server. Public served-byte verification is separate after deployment.

historical_baseline.scope: Older-build simulated headless combat only; not current-build visual combat or physical-phone acceptance
